text: Two problems with Lanternwake Harbor. 1) Every chat message sits inside a second, full-width box: you painted [data-mari-part="message"], which is the whole message row. Paint [data-mari-part="bubble"] (the bubble itself) instead and leave the row clear. 2) It's mostly a palette swap over the default look. Give it one structural idea of its own, as your theme-design handbook says (for example weathered plaster panels with rope-trim edges and lantern-glow selected states), and carry it through Home cards, the Library pages, Chat settings, the composer and the bubbles, both day and night. Also look at your header and background pictures with mari images look and tell me honestly whether the top-bar buttons read well on them; fix it if not. Keep day/night and the weather looks working.

Same two problems in Rainy Café: the second box around every message (paint [data-mari-part="bubble"], not the message row), and it's mostly a palette swap. Give it its own structural idea (for example ceramic tiles and enamel-mug edges, steam-soft shadows) across Home, Library, Chat settings, composer and bubbles, day and night. Then make 3 versions of a new Home picture for it (a cozy cafe counter with rain on the window, no people, no text), look at all 3 yourself, pick the best, add it to the theme as the Home art and tell me why you picked it.
